name: One-shots and Loops
maker: Sonic Pi contributors; each sound's Freesound uploader (listed in etc/samples/README.md)
licence_quote: All the bundled samples are individually licensed under a CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication. They have been obtained from freesound.org and links to their sources can be found in the file etc/samples/README.md
source: Sonic Pi sample set (etc/samples), at a pinned commit of the dev branch
notes: plain sound files for the sampler, no .sfz: ambient sounds (ambi_), glitches (glitch_), misc_, vinyl_ and loops (loop_), Sonic Pi's FLAC files unchanged

left out after reading each sound's Freesound page: loop_amen: the Amen break (The Winstons, 'Amen, Brother'), says its page; loop_amen_full: the Amen break, says its page; loop_compus: made with an Ableton Live factory kit (LD Compuspank), says its page; loop_safari: 'recorded in my keyboard': a keyboard's built-in content; loop_breakbeat: includes another user's sub bass, whose page is gone (404); vinyl_backspin: a scratch of an unnamed record on a turntable; vinyl_scratch: a scratch of an unnamed record; misc_crow: its Freesound page is gone (404); misc_cineboom: its Freesound page is gone (404)
